title.narrative: Meghalaya Power Distribution Sector Improvement Project

description.narrative: This is a stand-alone project estimated to cost $166 million. The Government of India has requested ADB to provide a loan of $133 million to finance the cost of distribution network improvement and construction of new substations including upgradation of existing substations with improved automation. The executing agency (EA), MeECL, will finance the contingencies, land acquisition, and project management expenses using counterpart funds.

03 Nov 2020 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-help-modernize-power-distribution-network-meghalaya
Grant 9213: 81% of contracts awarded and 12% disbursed as of 24 Apr 2025
Indicator: 1,440 km of new 33 kV and 11 kV distribution lines installed, and 774 kms of existing distribution lines upgraded; Status: All contracts have been awarded and design work is in progress.
Indicator: 136 auto-reclosers and 597 fault passage indicators installed in the networks.; Status: All contracts have been awarded and implementation is in progress.
Indicator: 23 new 33/11 kV substations commissioned; Status: All contracts have been awarded and implementation is in progress.
Indicator: 45 existing 33/11 kV substations upgraded and modernized; Status: All contracts have been awarded and implementation is in progress.

Indicator: Distribution network connecting 100% of households in three selected villages to mini grid system renovated; Status: Recruitment of consultancy firm to support project implementation is in the advanced stages. Expect commencement of bidding for the mini-grid system in Q1 2023.

Indicators: 100 individuals (at least 40% women) in Lower Jambal, Dilma Ading, and Kosigre villages trained in operation of solar photovoltaic-powered agricultural processing units; 200 individuals (at least 40% women) from Lower Jambal, Dilma Ading, and Kosigre villages and three selected schools reported increased awareness of mini grids for power generation and efficient use of electricity; Status: Consultancy contract was awarded in Q1 2022. Needs assessment and preliminary training activities commenced in June 2022. The tendering for the mini grids commenced in April 2023 and expect contract award by Q4 2023

Indicators: Solar photovoltaic-battery hybrid systems and agricultural processing units installed in Lower Jambal, Dilma Ading, and Kosigre villages; Rooftop solar photovoltaic systems installed in three selected schools; Status: Feasibility studies have been completed. Draft bidding documents have been prepared and reviewed by project implementation consultants. The draft bid documents submitted to power department for approval before bid commencement.
Installation and commissioning of smart meters is in progress. The meter-testing laboratory will be commissioned only after final commissioning of all the smart meters.
Loan 3996: 96% of contracts awarded and 57% disbursed as of 24 Apr 2025
Output: Capacity of executing agency to plan and implement distribution sector projects developed; Status: Consultants have been engaged and support for implementation is ongoing.
Progress Toward Outcome: Some delays in 2020 and 2021 due to COVID-19 restrictions. Restarted the installations in 2022.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Sep 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51308/51308-004-apfs-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Feb 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51308/51308-004-iee-en_33.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51308/51308-004-smr-en_4.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. One contract package for new/ augmentation substation is cancelled, and rebidding is on-going. Implementation for remaining new/ augmentation substations ongoing.2. Supply and installation of smart meters in progress. 3. The project implementation consultant is on board and supporting EA for preparation of distribution master plan. 4. Ongoing. The tendering for the mini grids commenced in April 2023. Consultants have been engaged and support for implementation is ongoing.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/51308-004/main#project-tenders
The physical installation of about single phase 92,900 smart meters completed, and final integration is in progress.
